title: Ulyana and the House
author: Lena Sterling
blurb: Zephyrine Nystrom, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
